name: Lava dragons

variantInfo.name: Lava dragon
notes: Found only on Lava Dragon Isle in the deep Wilderness (around levels 36-42).
Uses melee (slash) and short-ranged dragonfire; bring dragonfire protection.
Weak to water spells (50%); their low actual Magic and Ranged levels make magic and ranged accurate against them despite high defensive bonuses.
Drops lava dragon bones (high Prayer XP via the Chaos Altar) which draws player killers.

locationComparison.name: Lava Dragon Isle
notes: Deep Wilderness (around levels 36-42); a well-known player-killing hotspot.
Multi and cannon status are not wiki-stated, so treated conservatively as false.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 263 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Lava dragons is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns lava dragons as a Wilderness-only task; only Lava Dragon Isle kills count.
Lava dragons use melee and short-ranged dragonfire; bring an anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus an antifire potion.
Lava dragons are weak to water spells (50%); their actual Magic and Ranged levels are very low, so ranged and magic are accurate despite high defensive bonuses.
Lava Dragon Isle is deep Wilderness (levels 36-42) and a popular player-killing area; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose and keep a one-click teleport ready.
recommendedMethod: Kill lava dragons on Lava Dragon Isle with dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield plus antifire) and a strong ranged weapon such as Craw's bow or Dragon hunter crossbow, or Dragon hunter lance for melee. Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport given the deep-Wilderness risk.
